# Holidu

> > Holidu is a holiday rental search engine comparing prices across multiple platforms to help travelers find and book vacation accommodations across Europe and beyond.

Holidu aggregates holiday rentals from numerous booking sites, offering price comparison and travel guides for popular destinations including Italy, Greece, Spain, France, Portugal, Germany, and the UK. The platform provides both web-based search and a mobile app for finding and managing vacation rentals.

## Holiday Rental Search & Booking

- [Holidu App: The Smartest Way to Find, Book & Manage Holiday Rentals](https://www.holidu.co.uk/app): Mobile app for iOS/Android to find, book & manage holiday rentals
- [Holidu - Tuscany: Find the best holiday rentals & lettings](https://www.holidu.co.uk/s/italy/tuscany#!): 20,453+ holiday rentals in Tuscany, Italy from £35 with price comparison

## Travel Guides & Hidden Gems

- [Hidden Gems Santorini » Blogger tips for your next trip to Santorini](https://www.holidu.co.uk/magazine/hidden-gems-santorini): Travel guide featuring hidden gems & local tips for Santorini, Greece
- [Hidden Gems Hamburg » Blogger tips for your next trip to Hamburg](https://www.holidu.co.uk/magazine/hidden-gems-hamburg): Insider guide to Hamburg's Speicherstadt, cafes & hidden attractions
